title: Restrict the bundled setup wizard to the approved harnesses
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server edit src/setup/aiTool.ts so the interactive setup wizard no longer configures harnesses outside aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed (claude-code, opencode): remove or gate the Cursor, VS Code (Copilot), Windsurf and Claude Desktop registration paths and their configuration templates, keeping claude-code and opencode setup working, and extend vitest coverage for the pruned harness-selection step. Constraints: trunk-based development on protected branch main, one approving reviewer, blocking gitleaks and vitest CI gates, semgrep SAST advisory above high; first-party code change with no runtime or environment impact, so no deployment window applies.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the repo setup wizard (src/setup/aiTool.ts entry point, e.g. pnpm run setup) in a scratch clone offers only claude-code and opencode; no Cursor, VS Code (Copilot), Windsurf or Claude Desktop registration executes
grep -rniE 'cursor|windsurf' src/setup/ returns no matches and src/setup/aiTool.ts writes no configuration for any harness outside aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed
vitest unit tests covering the harness-selection step pass on the PR branch

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer inspects the src/setup/aiTool.ts diff to confirm the four unapproved harness registration branches are removed and only claude-code and opencode remain, then runs the wizard in a scratch clone and steps through the harness-selection prompt: expected result - only the two approved harnesses are offered and configured, and the vitest suite passes.

rootCause.description: The upstream setup wizard ships registrations for Cursor, VS Code (Copilot), Windsurf and Claude Desktop by default; it was never aligned to the company allowlist of claude-code and opencode
